Big Energy.description: Big Energy is a game I made for my senior capstone in highschool. It is a simple tile based strategy game about clean energy production

Bad Roommate.description: Bad Roomate is a game I made for the RIT Game Dev Club's Haloween Game Jam 2025 with a team of 3 others. It is a game where you try to be the worst roomate ever by making sure your roomate cant get their chores done.

Off The Clock.description: Off The Clock is a game I made with 2 others based on the theme of Do It Yourself. it is a typing simulator where you are a lazy guy who comes up with ever more rediculous excuses to not do various tasks.

Possesion.description: Possesion is a game I made for the Pixle Jam 2025, it is a top down dungeon crawler where you posses the corpses of your enemies instead of healing.

Melody.description: Melody is a game I made with a team at a summer camp. Melody is a platformer where you are a ghost that uses song to attack and make their own platforms.

Simple Tower Defence.description: This was the first game I made and was for a class in highscool. It is a tower defence game inspired by kingdom rush.
